subject: Urgent: inventory split & bonded storage for booth shipment
messages:
From: Nora Chen <nora@oceanfreightco.com>
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Diego Alvarez <diego.alvarez@pacificexhibits.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Provisional ETA + port hold: container 42GRU2112

Hi Markus / Laura,

Quick heads up — container 42GRU2112 (Redwood booth shipment) arrived at Pier 7 this morning but has been flagged by customs for missing Importer-of-Record paperwork. The terminal placed the container on a temporary hold pending IOR confirmation; estimated release window is 24–72 hours once we have the right docs.

We also learned that the terminal is short on immediate forklift slots this week. There are two practical options:

- Move the entire container into bonded warehouse (cost estimate attached) while HarborClear processes IOR and customs clearance (slower, preserves duties/deferral).
- Split the manifests: move crates 1–2 (demo hardware) to the advance warehouse for rush delivery to the venue, and transfer crates 3–6 into bonded storage until customs clears the rest. This requires updated release instructions from Redwood and coordination with Pacific Exhibit Services for internal pickup.

Attached is the provisional arrival notice (PAE_ETA_122334.pdf). If you choose the split, we need crate SKU confirmation and an authorization to the terminal by 16:00 local today to secure the early truck slot. Otherwise we can move the whole container to bonded and release later.

I can hold the container on the terminal for 24 hours at no additional charge; after that demurrage applies. Please advise ASAP so we can lock in the move.

Thanks,
Nora Chen
Operations Manager
Ocean Freight Co.
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: PAE_ETA_122334.pdf (provisional arrival notice, 2 pages)
From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Chen <nora@oceanfreightco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional ETA + port hold: container 42GRU2112

Nora — thanks for the quick update.

Laura / Tessa — looping you in. Laura, we need your sign-off on which crates are permitted to be split and sent to the venue advance warehouse today. Crates #1 and #2 are demo racks (high priority). Crates #3–#6 are booth structures, literature, and promo items — acceptable to hold in bonded if needed.

Can you confirm:
- Which exact SKUs / crate numbers you authorize to be released to the advance warehouse by EOD today?
- If we go bonded for crates 3–6, do you want HarborClear to invoice Redwood or Pacific Exhibit Services (Diego) for bonded fees?

Tessa, can events ops accept a partial delivery on short notice (forklift/curfew constraints)? Please note we will need internal pickup at the bonded warehouse later if customs delays persist.

If we cannot confirm by 16:00, please instruct Nora to move everything to bonded to avoid demurrage hit.

Markus Klein
Svcs & Events Ops, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
--

Date: 2026-08-02T07:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional ETA + port hold: container 42GRU2112

Markus / Nora —

Thanks. Confirming the split as follows:
- Release to advance warehouse (immediate): crates #1, #2 (demo racks + AV cabinets). These must be out for delivery to the venue no later than 48 hours after release.
- Move to bonded warehouse: crates #3, #4, #5, #6 (booth panels, literature, promo kits).

I've attached the latest packing list (redwood_packing_list_SKUs_v3.xlsx) with crate IDs and a highlighted column for the items that must go to the advance warehouse. Please use the SKU notes column for special handling (fragile foam inserts in crate #2).

Regarding payment: bill HarborClear / Ocean Freight Co. to Redwood (PO# RED-6789) for bonded storage; Diego (Pacific Exhibit Services) will assist with local pickup logistics once customs clears.

Nora — please submit the IOR waiver link to me and HarborClear for signature; Laura B. authorizes the split and bonded transfer per above.

Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0122

Cc: Diego Alvarez <diego.alvarez@pacificexhibits.com>, HarborClear Brokerage <broker@harborclear.com>, tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-05T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Container 42GRU2112 — split executed, bonded warehouse details + billing

Markus / Laura / Tessa —

Per Laura's authorization, we've executed the split this afternoon. Summary:
- Crates #1 & #2: moved to AdvanceWarehouse Bay 4; scheduled pickup to Venue Dock B at 05:30 on 2026-08-07. Truck docket: TRK-4491.
- Crates #3–#6: transferred to Blue Harbor Bonded (WHSE ID: BH-77) pending customs clearance. Bonded reference: BH/42GRU/08-05.

Attachments included: bonded_warehouse_invoice_stub.pdf (provisional), and a short IOR waiver DocuSign link (IOR-waiver-link.txt) for Laura to sign. HarborClear will require the waiver to clear duties; the DocuSign link expires in 7 days.

Billing: HarborClear will send a consolidated invoice to Redwood (PO RED-6789). If payment goes to Pacific Exhibit Services please cc billing@pacificexhibits.com on that thread.

Notes / action items:
- Laura: sign the DocuSign IOR waiver by 2026-08-08 to avoid additional hold time.
- Tessa: confirm venue forklift window and confirm TRK-4491 slot for on-site unload.
- Markus: confirm you want Redwood to accept bonded fees if customs holds extend beyond 5 business days (estimate attached).

Thanks — we'll update you when HarborClear submits entry and the container is cleared for release.

Best,
Nora Chen
Operations Manager
Ocean Freight Co.
